notes.title: Remake Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I wanted to give you all an update on the remake. 

Now that my game Unknown Presence is out, I am spending a bit of time fixing up issues and added things to that game, but once that is completed I will continue work on this remake.

I don't have an exact time frame yet but I will be sure to let you all know a release date once I have done more work on it.

If you have any suggestions on what you would like to see, please write them below and I will see what I can do!

Thank you

notes.title: Remake Update (New Info)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Quick update about the remake, I said that I was hoping to release the update sometime last month/this month. As of right now that won't happen unfortunately, due mainly to development on my other game as it is in the last stages and I am needing to work on it everyday. 
Also, in the remake I have decided to completely remake the house, as in a whole different layout with new stuff etc so that is taking some extra time!

Something I think everyone will love though, is that with this new house it is going to allow you to also go outside into the houses front and backyard which I feel like is going to be a large positive addition to the game which I hope you will all love! :)

In addition to that I am also using a new AI system for the AI components in the game. This new AI system is much more complex than the games original AI system, which should allow for better interactions with the AI in the game.

Thank you all so much for your patience so far, I am not trying to rush this update so I hope you all understand why it may take longer than first thought!

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We've got a special update for you today for Halloween! Here are the patch notes;

- Pumpkins added onto all* enemies around the base game (*There might be one or two without them.)
- Pumpkins, Cauldrons, and skulls added around the house and in all the other areas in the game.
- And a few little bug fixes.

This Halloween special update will run until November the 3rd, we hope you all enjoy this simple but awesome update.

notes.title: Update Situation
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I just wanted to let you all know that I am still updating The Entity but I am currently on holiday so am unable to do so for now. Updates will be slower once I get back though as we are very busy working on things. 
Please keep posting in the bug report forum so that we know what to fix once we get back!

Regards: Josh, Ragdoll Inc

notes.title: DLC Update V 1.01
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is the first official patch for The Entity: Returning Home. We have tried to fix most things people have said they have found so far. Here are the patch notes: 

- Main menu button is not working when prompted at the end of game.
- Fixed an issue where you could pick both options by moving far enough away at the end of DLC. 
- Fixed a bug where you could get the achievement "First Step" earlier than supposed too. 
- Fixed an issue where the achievements "Half-Way There", "Never To Return", and "Power items" couldn't be achieved. 
- Minor texture tweaks in the hell scene. 

Regards: Ragdoll Inc

notes.title: Update Delays
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We wanted to say sorry for not updating The Entity in quite a while, we are currently very busy with making sure our upcoming free DLC will be ready for launch. 

The progression for the DLC is going very well and we believe you will all like it. We will try and get back to updating The Entity once the DLC is done. Updates will not be as frequent as usual though as we haven't found anything that needs fixing or changing currently.

Regards: Ragdoll Inc

notes.title: Update V 1.16

notes.title: Update V 1.14

notes.title: Update V 1.11
notes.content:
Hello everyone, today's update is pretty big and important. Here are the patch notes:

- Added in two new areas that the player will be spawned to throughout the game. One is more of a puzzle style and the other is story driven.
- Added a new walking enemy that will spawn under certain conditions.
- Added a consiquence to being caught by the walk enemies.
- Added in a object that appears around the house.
- Added a few extra object related stuff for you guys to find.
- Further fixed an issue where the walking enemies would get stuck on doors.
- Fixed a problem where you could turn lights on and open doors at the sametime(Let us know if it still happens).
- Some minor optmizations in relation to random lights and some shadow problems.
- And other minor bug fixes

We hope you all enjoy this update as we have added a lot of things in that we really believe everyone will love!

Regards: Ragdoll Inc

notes.title: Update Delay
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We wanted to let you all know that we have been paying attention to what you all have been saying. The next update for The Entity will be later than others (Maybe tomorrow or a day or two after that) as we are doing a lot of upgrades and some changes/additions that we really believe you will all like and appreciate!

We would really like to say thank you to everyone that has been telling us what needs changing and fixing, if it wasn't for you we wouldn't be able to improve the game.

As the update will take longer to do please let us know of any suggestions that you would like fixed/added in. We will try and add/fix anything that you suggest(Within reason).

Regards: Ragdoll Inc

*The walking enemy can get stuck if the player blocks a doorway, we are working on fixing this so please keep that in mind. We are also aware of the large hang on the black screen when first starting the game and going into the house*

Regards: Ragdoll Inc

We also just wanted to say thank you for all the support everyone has been giving us, we have way more wishlists & followers to the page than we ever thought it would get! :)
